name: Pension Credit
description: Tops up income to £218/week (single). Gateway benefit — unlocks Winter Fuel Payment and free TV Licence.
eligibility_summary: Tops up weekly income to at least £218.15 (single) or £332.95 (couple) in 2024/25. Gateway benefit — unlocks Winter Fuel Payment, free TV Licence (75+) and other entitlements. About 1 in 3 eligible pensioners don't claim.
